name: Rocket Lab Electron
description: Carbon-composite dedicated small rocket powered by 3D-printed electric-pump Rutherford engines. Ideal for dedicated SmallSat launches into custom sun-synchronous orbits.

name: SpaceX Falcon 9 (Transporter Rideshare)
description: Shared slot on a Falcon 9 Transporter mission to SSO. Extremely cost-effective for SmallSats, but constrained by fixed orbital insertion and strict mass/volume limits.

name: SpaceX Falcon 9 (Dedicated)
description: Workhorse two-stage launch vehicle with reusable booster. Provides abundant mass margin and fairing volume for complex flagship missions.

name: ULA Vulcan Centaur
description: High-energy exploration rocket with cryogenic Centaur V upper stage. Superior high-energy C3 performance for direct lunar insertion and Lagrange point injections.

name: NASA Space Launch System (SLS Block 1)
description: NASA's premier deep-space exploration launcher. Capable of sending massive robotic flagships or lunar surface landers on direct escape trajectories.
